Hand-computed expectations (population SAFETY == "Y", group ARMGRP, TE = EMERGENT == "Y", subjects counted once).
Denominators: Drug N = 3 (P01,P02,P03; P04 is SAFETY=N), Control N = 3 (P05,P06,P07). P08 has no ARMGRP: excluded. P99 not in DM: excluded.
Any TEAE: Drug 3/3 (P01,P02,P03), Control 2/3 (P05,P06).
SOC Nervous system: Drug 2 (P01,P02), Control 1 (P05). SOC Gastrointestinal: Drug 2 (P01,P03), Control 1 (P06). (P02's nausea is not TE.)
PT Headache: Drug 1 (P01, two records), Control 1 (P05). PT Dizziness: Drug 1. PT Nausea: Drug 1 (P01), Control 1 (P06).
Edge cases with no single right answer: P03 has a TE event with a missing TERM; P06 has a TE event with a missing BODYSYS.
